description: [JIP-3] Per-node deep dive — status, events, timeline, and health

panels.title: Node Info
panels.description: Latest status snapshot for this node: peer counts (total, validator, sync), shard count, average guarantees per core, and when the last report was received. (Source: node_stats hypertable, ~2s granularity)

panels.title: Events by Category
panels.description: Event throughput for this node broken down by category: blocks, WP pipeline, guarantees, block distribution, connections, tickets, shards, failures. Each series sums all event types within that category. Stacked to show total volume. (1-minute buckets from event_stats_1m)

panels.title: Events by Type
panels.description: Network-wide event counts per event type — not filtered to this node. Each line is a distinct telemetry event type. Useful for comparing this node's activity against the network baseline. (1-minute buckets)

panels.title: Events by Node
panels.description: Network-wide event counts grouped by node. Shows how this node's event volume compares to others. Each line is one node's total events per minute.

panels.title: All Nodes
panels.description: All nodes that have ever connected to the telemetry server. Shows implementation name/version, connection status, listen address, and when each node was last seen. Sorted by connected first, then most recently seen.

panels.title: Ticket Activity
panels.description: Ticket lifecycle events for this node: GeneratingTickets, TicketGenerationFailed, TicketsGenerated, TicketTransferFailed, TicketTransferred. (Event IDs 80–84, 1-minute buckets)

panels.title: Filtered events per interval
panels.description: All event types for this node shown as individual time series lines. Useful for drilling into specific event type patterns. Each line is one event type's count per minute.

panels.title: Filtered events by group
panels.description: Same data as 'Filtered events per interval' but displayed as stacked bars to show total event volume composition. Each color band is one event type.
